findings.highlight: the European branch of Touma Youko Office
findings.evidenceJa: 冬馬曜子オフィス欧州本部
findings.explanation: Urgent callers are directed to the European headquarters, not another branch. The headquarters/branch distinction matters because the Japanese office has suspended operations and Europe is now carrying the organization.
findings.japanese:
「お急ぎのご用がありましたら、
冬馬曜子オフィス欧州本部に連絡をお願いします。
電話番号は…」
findings.todokanai: "If you have urgent business, please contact the European branch of Touma Youko Office. The number to them is…"

findings.highlight: Just how long is Miyoko's vacation, exactly…?
findings.evidenceJa: いつまで休んでんだよ、美代子さん
findings.explanation: Kazusa is complaining to Miyoko about how long the Japanese office remains closed or inactive after the recorded announcement. Todokanai TL invents a personal vacation, though the surrounding lines establish a suspended branch rather than ordinary leave.
findings.japanese: 「いつまで休んでんだよ、美代子さん…」
findings.todokanai: "Just how long is Miyoko's vacation, exactly…?"

findings.evidenceJa: 受話器を置く手がどうにも重かった
findings.explanation: Imagining the wasted international charge makes Kazusa's hand heavy as she puts down the receiver. Todokanai TL replaces the concrete reluctance to hang up with a generic headache.
findings.japanese:
たった数秒とはいえ、
無駄になった日本への国際通話料の金額を想像すると、
受話器を置く手がどうにも重かった。
findings.todokanai: The call might have only lasted for a few seconds, but just imagining the fee for international calls to Japan makes my head hurt.

findings.highlight: I've been greeted by the answering machine the entire month.
findings.evidenceJa: 日本支部はほぼ開店休業状態ってことらしかった
findings.explanation: Ten calls and nearly a month of answering-machine responses lead Kazusa to conclude that the Japanese branch is effectively open in name only. Todokanai TL gives the call history but omits that explicit organizational conclusion.
findings.japanese:
最初にかけてから１０回連続、
ほぼ一か月間ずっと留守電のままということから、
日本支部はほぼ開店休業状態ってことらしかった。
findings.todokanai: This is the tenth time since I first called her, and I've been greeted by the answering machine the entire month.

findings.highlight: Mom managed to bring herself to ask for that song
findings.evidenceJa: 母さんが喉の奥から絞り出した曲名
findings.explanation: Youko squeezed the title out from deep in her throat, a bodily image consistent with her failing strength. Todokanai TL makes the difficulty psychological reluctance to ask, altering the scene's account of her condition.
findings.japanese:
あの、母さんが喉の奥から絞り出した曲名を聞いてから、
はや一月…
findings.todokanai: It's been a month since Mom managed to bring herself to ask for that song…

findings.highlight: After the third orchestra I tried to negotiate with…
findings.explanation: Kazusa gave up on the telephone campaign at the third office. Todokanai TL omits the actual failure and leaves the sentence unfinished.
findings.japanese:
最初のうちは、レッスンの合間を縫って、
電話帳で探したオケの事務所にかたっぱしから
電話を掛けて交渉しようとして…三箇所目で挫折した。
findings.todokanai: At first, I used the time between my lessons to check the phone book for all orchestras from A to Z. After the third orchestra I tried to negotiate with…

findings.highlight: Getting an email address and functioning internet took another three.
findings.evidenceJa: そして、文面を考えるのに、さらに３日間
findings.explanation: The comic schedule is three days for the computer, three for email and internet, and another three merely composing the message. Todokanai TL drops the third equal interval and therefore the setup for 'nearly ten days' on the next line.
findings.japanese:
パソコンのセットアップに３日間。
メールやインターネットのセットアップに３日間。
そして、文面を考えるのに、さらに３日間。
findings.todokanai: It took me three days to get the computer running. Getting an email address and functioning internet took another three.

findings.highlight: every single orchestra in the phone book, whose email addresses I found on the web.
findings.evidenceJa: ｗｅｂ上で探したオケのメールアドレスに、片っ端から送って…返ってきたのは質問の嵐だった
findings.explanation: The addresses themselves were found on the web, not in the phone book, and the mass mailing produced a storm of questions. Todokanai TL combines contradictory sources and omits the response that drives the next line.
findings.japanese:
そんな、１０日近くもかけて作り上げた文面を、
ｗｅｂ上で探したオケのメールアドレスに、
片っ端から送って…返ってきたのは質問の嵐だった。
findings.todokanai: After nearly ten days worth of effort, the resulting message was sent to every single orchestra in the phone book, whose email addresses I found on the web.

findings.highlight: About the pay, about the scheduling, about the venue…
findings.evidenceJa: 結局、その返信にまた三日かかり、さらに返ってきたのは疑問と怒りとお断りの嵐だった
findings.explanation: It took Kazusa another three days to answer questions about money, schedule, and venue, after which she received a storm of confusion, anger, and refusals. Todokanai TL deletes the complete result and leaves only the list of subjects.
findings.japanese:
お金のこととか、日程のこととか、会場のこととか、
結局、その返信にまた三日かかり、
さらに返ってきたのは疑問と怒りとお断りの嵐だった。
findings.todokanai: About the pay, about the scheduling, about the venue…

findings.highlight: the headquarters of our European branch just couldn't bear to watch any longer.
findings.evidenceJa: 欧州本部のスタッフが、オケとの交渉を一手に引き受けてくれた
findings.explanation: The European headquarters staff took over all negotiation with orchestras. Todokanai TL supplies only their exasperated observation and omits the action that explains why Kazusa is now calling Emma for results.
findings.japanese:
そんなこんなで、無駄に半月ほど費やした頃、
見るに見かねた欧州本部のスタッフが、
オケとの交渉を一手に引き受けてくれた。
findings.todokanai: After seeing me run around like a headless chicken for nearly half a month, the headquarters of our European branch just couldn't bear to watch any longer.

findings.highlight: It's the means I hated most of all.
findings.evidenceJa: 『日本人ピアニスト』『冬馬曜子の娘』というキンキラキンの看板が一番目立つ国を利用する、自分が一番嫌ってた悪趣味な手
findings.explanation: Kazusa considers exploiting the country where the gaudy labels 'Japanese pianist' and 'Touma Youko's daughter' carry the greatest promotional force. Todokanai TL omits the entire substance of the tactic, leaving only that she hated it.
findings.japanese:
それは『日本人ピアニスト』『冬馬曜子の娘』という
キンキラキンの看板が一番目立つ国を利用する、
自分が一番嫌ってた悪趣味な手。
findings.todokanai: It's the means I hated most of all.

findings.highlight: would probably end in failure… No, it would definitely end in failure.
findings.evidenceJa: そんな赤字覚悟…というか、赤字確実の興行
findings.explanation: The planned concert would probably—indeed certainly—run at a financial loss. Todokanai TL changes red ink into artistic or practical failure, obscuring the extravagance of importing an entire Japanese orchestra to Vienna.
findings.japanese:
そんな赤字覚悟…というか、
赤字確実の興行を計画するところまで、
追い詰められていた。
findings.todokanai: I felt so cornered that I found no other choice but to rely on something that would probably end in failure… No, it would definitely end in failure.

findings.highlight: the very first orchestra I sent a request to
findings.evidenceJa: ここから歩いて五分の市民オケ
findings.explanation: The reply comes from a civic orchestra only a five-minute walk away. Todokanai TL omits the striking proximity, a concrete irony after Kazusa's sprawling and unsuccessful international search.
findings.japanese:
アドレスを確認すると、
一番最初にメールを出したけど返事の来なかった、
ここから歩いて五分の市民オケからだった。
findings.todokanai: Checking the address, I noticed it was from the very first orchestra I sent a request to, but never got any response from.

findings.highlight: Any orchestra he commands always fills every seat at their concerts, and he's booked solid until next year.
findings.evidenceJa: 自身が率いるオーケストラの定期公演はいつも満席。それどころか一年先まで予約で一杯
findings.explanation: It is Dupre's own orchestra whose regular subscription concerts are always sold out, with reservations filled a year ahead. Todokanai TL generalizes this to any orchestra he happens to command and leaves what is booked ambiguous.
findings.japanese:
自身が率いるオーケストラの定期公演はいつも満席。
それどころか一年先まで予約で一杯。
まさに今、脂の乗った気鋭の指揮者と言える。
findings.todokanai: Any orchestra he commands always fills every seat at their concerts, and he's booked solid until next year.

findings.evidenceJa: フランツ・デュプレ・オーケストラ
findings.explanation: The orchestra is the Franz Dupre Orchestra everywhere else in the same scene. 'Dubre' creates a second spelling for the same named ensemble at a line emphasizing its extraordinary availability.
findings.japanese:
そもそも、フランツ・デュプレ・オーケストラを
年内で押さえることができたのは奇跡だったらしい。
findings.todokanai: The very fact that the Franz Dubre Orchestra could even find an opening within the year is a miracle in and of itself.
